name: entalpa
description: Spec-driven development in Codex: keep user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria in Entalpa, draft PRDs from them, and have Codex implement against that spec, linking the code back to each requirement it covers. Imports and exports OpenSpec and GitHub Spec Kit. Requires a free Entalpa account.

interface.longDescription: Spec-driven development in Codex: keep user stories, requirements and acceptance criteria in Entalpa, draft PRDs from them, and have Codex implement against that spec, linking the code back to each requirement it covers. Imports and exports OpenSpec and GitHub Spec Kit. Requires a free Entalpa account.
defaultPrompt: Use Entalpa to inspect my project, identify missing requirements, and preserve traceability.
Use Entalpa to implement the current requirements and record implementation evidence.
Use Entalpa to generate a grounded PRD or BRD from the current project.
Use Entalpa to bring this repository's OpenSpec or Spec Kit specs into one current spec.
